messages:
alex.s: Quick heads-up — finalizing cloud syndication/handoff guidelines w/ CloudVendor. Need marketing + partnerships alignment for next Tue launch.

maria.g: Can we list required assets? I'm thinking: 1) co-branded blog post 2) marketplace listing copy + screenshots 3) co-hosted webinar (30-45m) 4) gated joint demo (video + slides).

ben.k: Important: who owns inbound lead routing? We should avoid duplicate MQLs between Redwood CRM and CloudVendor.

ria_p: I'll own CRM mapping. Need the field map from CloudVendor (utm_source, partner_id, vendor_lead_id). Also want example tracking urls.

partner-jill: From partner side: we can provide vendor_lead_id and an initial syndication feed (CSV). Their marketplace requires a high-res logo (PNG, 300x300) and short 70-char blurb. Can we confirm deadlines? :calendar:

alex.s: Deadline proposal: assets ready by Fri EOD, final approvals Mon, syndication live Tue morning. Agree?

maria.g: Agree. I'll draft blog outline by Wed and circulate. Will include benchmark / performance callouts — keep claims conservative.

ben.k: Routing proposal: CloudVendor posts leads to webhook -> our partner intake service -> dedupe by email + vendor_lead_id -> create lead in SFDC with Lead Source=CloudVendor. Who's owning webhook endpoint?

ria_p: I'll own the SFDC mapping + dedupe rules. Ben, can you confirm webhook auth method?

partner-jill: We support HMAC auth header. Example: Authorization: HMAC key=abcd1234

ben.k: Perfect. I'll stand up endpoint and share test creds.

deploy-bot: uploaded file: <https://files.redwood.ai/marketing/cloud-syndication-spec-v1.pdf>

maria.g: Quick note on messaging: avoid “cheaper” claims. Focus on “predictable throughput” and “seamless deployment options.” Also include a short customer quote placeholder.

alex.s: Action items summary: 1) maria - blog + landing draft by Wed 2) ben - webhook + test creds by Thu 3) ria - SFDC mapping by Thu 4) partner-jill - feed + logo by Thu EOD 5) alex - approval loop Mon. I'll run a 30-min sync Fri 9am PT. :thumbsup:

partner-jill: Thx — will send logo + sample feed today.

ben.k: Noted. Will post etl test results in thread when done.

ria_p: Adding UTM template for the team to use:
```
utm_source=cloudvendor&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=cloud-syndication-2026&utm_content=listing
```

alex.s: Thanks all — feel free to ping me if any blockers. I'll create the calendar invite for Fri 9am PT. :calendar:
